SamenvattingLooking for a dynamic role in logistics with a well-known supermarket in Almere? As an Orderpicker, you’ll work in a fast-paced environment, enjoy great benefits, and have opportunities to grow. Start your logistics career in Almere today. Good work!Over de functieYou will play a key role in making sure supermarket products reach customers on time. Your daily work as an Orderpicker involves collecting supermarket items from the warehouse shelves and preparing orders for delivery. You’ll use hand scanners and work both in cold and warm areas, so you need to be ready for different environments. Each shift is active and can include a lot of walking.
- Pick and scan supermarket products for customer orders
- Work in both warm and cold areas of the warehouse
- Meet weekly picking targets and quality standards
- Keep your workspace organized and clean
- Switch between departments when needed

You’ll work day shifts (6:00-14:30), evening shifts (14:30-23:00), and after training, potentially night shifts (23:00-6:00) from Monday till Saturday.
Over het bedrijfAt this leading logistics company, you’ll become part of the team that keeps supermarket shelves stocked and customer orders moving. The workplace in Almere is a modern warehouse where efficiency and teamwork are highly valued. You can expect a friendly vibe, with team members supporting each other and a buddy system in place to help new colleagues get started. In the canteen, you’ll find free fruit and a warm meal during afternoon shifts, plus a coffee and tea station to keep you energized. If you enjoy an active job and being part of a supportive team, this is the place for you.

- Able to speak and understand English
- Available for at least 32 hours per week, including Saturdays
- Willing to work in both cold and warm areas and switch departments as needed
- Punctual, reliable, and a good team player

Do you have a strong eye for detail and a passion for data within the fast-paced fashion industry? Please note this is not an active vacancy; we are building a talent pool of skilled Fashion Product Data Coordinators/Specialists for future opportunities.
 
If you excel at managing and analyzing data, maintaining accuracy, and collaborating with cross-functional teams, this is your opportunity to stay ahead and be among the first considered for exciting new roles.
 
What You’ll Do
As a Fashion Product Data Coordinator/Specialist, you will:

- Ensure the quality, accuracy, and completeness of product-related data in systems like PLM and PIM.

- Create and deliver KPI reports on data integrity, sustainability metrics, sample deliveries, and product development progress.

- Collaborate with product development, merchandising, and design teams to maintain seamless data management throughout the product life cycle.

- Perform data cleansing and quality assessments, identifying opportunities for improvement.

- Generate actionable insights to enhance decision-making and visibility into performance areas.

- Work on ad-hoc reporting and analysis requests for divisional teams and leadership.

- Partner with global teams to streamline workflows and ensure consistency across regions.

Who You Are

- You have 2-3 years of experience in data coordination, analytics, or reporting—ideally within fashion, retail, or product development.

- You have excellent communication skills in English (written en verbal).

- You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.

- You are highly proficient in Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP) and PowerPoint.

- Experience with PLM systems and PIM (e.g., Centric PLM) is a strong advantage.

- You have strong organizational and analytical skills with an eye for detail.

- You communicate fluently in English (both written and verbal).

- You thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

jobs.description:
You work in the finishing department, in a small team of about four colleagues. You do the work yourself, and because of your experience, you are also the person colleagues come to.

- You fit valves onto gas cylinders
- You inspect and test cylinders, a kind of MOT check
- You record all data per cylinder in the system (Access)
- You divide the work and keep an eye on progress
- You think beyond your own task and spot it early when something might go wrong
- You are the link between the shift supervisor and your colleagues

You like working with your hands and you lead by example. You are looking for a place to stay for the long term.

- You have experience in a technical production environment, preferably a rough one
- Physical work and a dirty, hot or cold workplace don't put you off
- You bring people together and are comfortable addressing colleagues about agreements
- You work accurately, because nothing can go wrong during an inspection
- You are good with computers, because registration is a big part of the job
- You speak good English; Dutch is a plus
- Forklift experience is a plus
